sources.heading: Connect the sources you use
sources.body: Bring together your own accounts, public information and files. Explore the source types supported by Umwelt-OS.
sources.availability: Available sources depend on your workspace configuration. Some require credentials, provider approval or separate read-only authorization. Markdown, OFX and CSV are manual imports.
aiHeading: Ask one question across your sources
aiBody: Search, summarize, organize and compare collected information through AI features available in your workspace.
evidenceHeading: Follow each answer back to its source
evidenceBody: Open source references to inspect the material behind an answer and review important details in context.
workspaceHeading: Bring useful information into your day
workspaceBody: Use dashboards, news, tasks and configured automations to keep collected information close to the work you follow.
step.two: Connect sources available to your setup.
step.three: Collect information, then ask AI about it.
privacyHeading: You stay in control of your workspace
privacyBody: Optional AI providers and integrations can receive information used by their features. Review Privacy to understand data handling and Google sign-in.
faq.heading: Common questions
faq.sourcesQuestion: Which data sources can I connect?
faq.sourcesAnswer: Available sources depend on the connectors implemented and configured by your workspace operator. Setup may require credentials or provider approval.
faq.googleQuestion: Does Google sign-in read my Gmail, Calendar or Drive?
faq.googleAnswer: No. Google sign-in verifies your identity only. Separate read-only connectors can collect selected Gmail, Calendar or Drive content after you configure a source and authorize that connector.
faq.aiQuestion: Does the preview use my data or a live AI model?
faq.aiAnswer: No. This preview uses fixed illustrative content in your browser. Sign in to use the sources and AI models configured for your workspace.
finalBody: Start exploring the information you have collected in your workspace.
